subject: Attention Mechanisms
object: limitations of vanilla attention and self-attention
source_sentence: As future work, we would like to experiment with other attention mechanisms such as multi-head attention, directional self-attention, block self-attention, or hierarchical attention, since they have been shown to address the limitations of vanilla attention and self-attention by either incorporating information from different representation subspaces at different positions to capture both local and long-range context dependencies, encoding temporal order information, or by attending to context dependencies at different levels of granularity.
title: Dialogue Act Classiﬁcation with Context-Aware Self-Attention
